#  23442 - New Technologies in Reinforced Concrete Design Modulübersicht  
|  Module Number:   | **23442 - module is no longer offered from WS 2026/27**  |  
| --- | --- |  
| Module Title:  | **New Technologies in Reinforced Concrete Design**  |  
|  Neue Technologien für bewehrte Betonkonstruktionen   |  
| Department:  |  Faculty 6 - Architecture, Civil Engineering and Urban Planning   |  
| Responsible Staff Member:  | 
  * Prof. Dr.-Ing. Bleicher, Achim 

 |  
| Language of Teaching / Examination:  | English  |  
| Duration:  | 1 semester  |  
| Frequency of Offer:  |  Every semester   |  
| Credits:  |  
| Learning Outcome:  |  **Knowledge** Getting well known with new construction materials and techniques, especially concerning concrete. Prefabrication is an idustrialized process with a large potential for the future. The construction industy requires a wide choice in the selection of building components. The seminar is intended to fill the gap by providing a detailed review of the subject.**Application** Application of basic knowledge of concrete materials to high strength concretes and concrete mixtures with additional capabilities. Application of these concretes in prefabrication.**Abilities** Transfer of research results into rules/codes for design. Modification of existing rules to materials with different or extended properties  |  
| Contents:  |  **Prefabrication** Structural precast systems; production, transport and erection; standards concerning prefabrication,bearing walls, skeletal systems, precast floors, corbels, stabilizing systems, connections**Design of High-Tec composits** Water impermeable concretes; fibre concretes and industrial floors, light weight concretes, ultra highstrength concretes, reinforcing with laminates  |  
| Recommended Prerequisites:  | None  |  
| Mandatory Prerequisites:  | None  |  
| Forms of Teaching and Proportion:  | 
  * Seminar / 4 Hours per Week per Semester 
  * Self organised studies / 120 Hours 

 |  
| Teaching Materials and Literature:  |  **Prefabrication**
  * FIP-Planning and Design Handbook on Precast Building Structures,
  * Bindseil: Stahlbetonfertigteile, 3. Aufl., Werner, 2007

**Design of High-Tec composits**
  * Lecture notes of Chair of Structural Concrete

 |  
| Module Examination:  | Continuous Assessment (MCA)  |  
| Assessment Mode for Module Examination:  | 
  * Structural Analysis of a prefabricated basement (50%)
  * Oral presentation and discussion of results (50%)

 |  
| Evaluation of Module Examination:  | Performance Verification – graded  |  
| Limited Number of Participants:  | None  |  
| Part of the Study Programme:  | 
  * no assignment

 |  
| Remarks:  | WW2In the event that the module cannot be taught or tested according to the present description (e.g. for reasons of infection protection), the alternatives communicated on relevant platforms (e.g. homepage or Moodle) apply.  |  
| Module Components:  | Seminar  |  
| Components to be offered in the Current Semester:  | 
  * no assignment

 |  
| Follow-up Module/s:  |  Phase-out module since: 14.07.2015 
  * without Follow-up Module/s
